cohorts.recruitment: University College London Hospital, January 2008 to September 2021. Consecutive clinic attendees aged 16 or older with a unicornuate uterus. Only women with a noncommunicating rudimentary horn contribute.
cohorts.ascertainment: Systematic specialist pelvic ultrasound and clinical and surgical histories. Functional endometrium was visible in the rudimentary horn. The ultrasound criteria for endometriosis describe nodules and endometriomas. Horn excision records a procedure.
